browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium from node_modules/.pnpm, headless, 1440x900, one isolated browser context per identity

fixturePreparation.text: Jonas Weber submitted four Legal question Requests through the Portal API (R-134, R-135, R-136, R-137). Daniel Okafor converted R-134 to Contract C-312, R-135 to Matter M-172, and R-137 to Contract C-313 through the convert API; R-136 stays unconverted. Daniel added Nadia Haddad to the C-312 and M-172 teams through the team API. The Request submission and conversion procedures belong to other guides.

Notification events were arranged by posting comments through the comments API as the acting role (Daniel Okafor, Nadia Haddad) on C-312, M-172, and R-136; the notification steps under test were then followed in the browser.
Jonas Weber submitted R-138 through the Requests API from his Portal session for the New requests and Request receipt checks.
Daniel Okafor added Amara Nwosu (Business User, not the Requester) to the C-312 team through the team API for the team-member comparison.
Daniel Okafor uploaded two fictional PDFs (doc029-conv-portal-note.pdf, doc029-conv-schedule.pdf) to C-312 through the documents API and moved its status to undefined through the contract API.
Daniel Okafor removed Amara Nwosu from the C-312 team after the comparison (HTTP 200).
Daniel Okafor removed and restored Jonas Weber on the C-312 team through the team API for the Portal bell access check.

Daniel Okafor invited four fresh fictional accounts through the invites API (three Legal Team Members and one Administrator, all named "DOC-029 conversations ... 205399"). Each set a random in-memory password from its activation mail, signed in, and had its timezone set to Pacific/Honolulu through the preferences API so no morning round could serve it before its fixtures were ready.

Daniel Okafor added the four fresh accounts to the C-312 team, created one Task due 2026-09-16 for "Member No Date Bell" and for "Admin No Date Email", and added two Key dates on 2026-09-23 (DOC-029 conversations 205399 board pack, DOC-029 conversations 205399 filing window) through the API. Global reminder lead times in this lab: {"offsets":[30,14,7,1,0]}.

The Member Dates, Member No Date Bell, and Admin No Date Email accounts had their timezone set to America/New_York (local hour 11) through the preferences API; Member Before Eight stayed on Pacific/Honolulu (local hour 5).

A morning round was queued as notification.morning-round in the lab's own pg-boss queue (job d837933b-a095-41c4-adf3-b1a41d7e5515) instead of waiting for the hourly cron; the worker ran it with its real clock, rules, notifier, and mailer.
Daniel Okafor removed the selected recipient of DOC-029 conversations 205399 narrowed review from the C-312 team through the team API and restored it after the check.
